concept: One five-second stopwatch with a sky-blue dial, shot close up and off centre four ways. At the head of the dial the hand stands on zero beside the question, then goes. At the foot it stops on 2.5, where the flange stops being navy. At the shoulder it stops on 4, where the flange turns red. Then the camera pulls back to the hub as the hand flies back to zero beside 'Time yours.' and the address. Sky-blue enamel, navy print, steel, and one red hand.
